OFFICIAL_TRUTH.text:
World's Best Ventilating Mattress

Auping mattresses ventilate better than any other mattress. The unique Night Air Technology® combines a fully open mattress structure with a breathable Vent‑tex® comfort layer. 

This allows air to circulate freely throughout the mattress, while heat and moisture are quickly expelled. The result? Your body stays at the perfect temperature, helping you sleep deeper, cooler, and fresher.

The Right Support

Hundreds of dynamic pocket springs move independently and adapt precisely to your body. They provide extra support for your shoulders, hips, and lower back.

Whether you sleep on your side, back, or stomach, your spine stays in a natural, relaxed alignment. This ensures you wake up every morning feeling rested and full of energy.

Sustainable Quality

Every mattress is crafted with care and attention in Deventer. Modern technology and high-quality, designed for circularity come together in a mattress that embodies true craftsmanship.

As the world’s first mattress fully designed for circularity, it promises a future without waste: every component can be reused. With this mattress, you not only sleep well, but also contribute directly to a cleaner, more sustainable world.
